answer: A real operator remembers what was agreed three turns ago and builds on it; a scripted reply treats every turn as the first. The network tests dialogue state memory by checking whether later turns correctly reuse facts established earlier, and a session that forgets its own earlier statements fails the test. A wander that appears twice is the tell: the same session cannot live twice. A zephyr alone is noise; a sonnet of consistent sessions is a pattern the network can trust.
